KeyPassages: Exodus 14:21; Numbers 13:28; Judges 14:14; Song of Solomon 8:6
BiblicalUsage: Az means strong, vehement, harsh — strength at full force. The east wind divided the Red Sea, the spies said the people of the land were stronger than Israel, Samson's riddle says out of the strong came forth sweetness, and the Song says love is strong as death, jealousy is cruel as the grave, and its coals are coals of fire.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe love strong as death is the strongest thing in Scripture. I hold that the same strength that split the sea is the strength that holds me.
